Name: Jokmeam in Ephraim
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Ephraim (Tel al Mazar and Tell Simadi both proposed)
Description: A Levitical city in Ephraim named in 1 Chronicles 6, given with its suburbs to the Kohathites — distinct from the Jokmeam of Solomon's district list in 1 Kings 4.
BiblicalSignificance: Its only appearance is the Levitical list, where it stands among the Ephraimite cities set apart for the Levites' service.
